in_sanskrit.name: राणजित
in_sanskrit.meaning: राण (rāṇa) + जित (jit) = राजा (rājā) + जित (jit) = राजित् (rājit) = ruler + victorious = conquering ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who conquers or rules

in_hindi.name: रानाजित
in_hindi.meaning: राण (rāṇa) + जित (jit) = राजा (rājā) + जित (jit) = राजित् (rājit) = राजा जित (rājā jit) = king + victorious = conquering king
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who conquers or rules as a king

in_tamil.name: ராநாஜித்
in_tamil.meaning: ராணம் (rāṇam) + ஜித் (jit) = ராஜா (rājā) + ஜித் (jit) = ராஜித் (rājith) = ராஜா ஜித் (rājā jith) = ஜீவத்மிக்கு விக்கியத்தில் விடும் பெரிய வீரன் (jīvathmikku vikkyathill vidum periya veēraṉ) = a mighty warrior who rules over a living being
in_tamil.long_meaning: A mighty warrior who rules over a living being

in_telugu.name: రానాజిట్
in_telugu.meaning: రాణము (rāṇamu) + జిత్ (jit) = రాజా (rājā) + జిత్ (jit) = రాజిట్ (rājita) = రాజజిత్ (rājajit) = జీవదేశపేద్దళే వీరుడు (jīvadēśapēddalē vēruḍu) = a mighty warrior who rules over a living being
in_telugu.long_meaning: A mighty warrior who rules over a living being

in_marathi.name: Ranajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Judge of the people
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the judge or ruler of the people

in_bengali.name: Ranajit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Judge of the people
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ranajit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is the judge or ruler of the people
